subject: Synergenics — split payout accounts (bank migration) and fulfillment address change

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor update: new banks + fulfillment address change

Hi Irene,

Quick heads-up from Synergenics finance: we're migrating our primary payout account for licensing/service fees to a new bank and, separately, routing hardware and fulfillment vendor payments to a distinct corporate account. The reason is that our procurement/fulfillment function moved to a new warehouse (address below) and the finance team requires a separate ledger for inventory/liability accounting.

Effective date for the split: 2026-12-15.

What I'm attaching:
- synergenics_w9_updated_2026.pdf (updated W-9, legal name unchanged)
- bank_letter_licensing_ending_1123.pdf (new ACH instructions for licensing)
- bank_letter_hardware_ending_4487.pdf (new ACH instructions for hardware/fulfillment)

New fulfillment/ship-to (warehouse):
Synergenics Logistics – Bay 4
1187 Meridian Park Drive
Ridgeview, CA 94035

AP email to receive invoices: invoices@synergenics.com
Payment disputes contact: Marco Ramos <marco.ramos@synergenics.com> (Finance Ops)

Please let me know the onboarding steps your team needs from us (voided checks, additional forms, any DocuSign), and an ETA for when the vendor record will reflect the two remit accounts so our team can align PO creation.

Thanks — Natalie
Natalie Tran
Head of Finance Operations
Synergenics Inc.
Attachments: 3 files (PDF)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor update: new banks + fulfillment address change

Hi Natalie — thanks for the quick notice and the attachments. We'll start the internal process, and a couple clarifying items so we don't have to back-and-forth later: 

1) Confirm the exact account names that should appear on the vendor record for each remit location (e.g., "Synergenics Inc. — Licensing" vs "Synergenics Inc. — Fulfillment").
2) Do you want POs for hardware to route to the new fulfillment address above? (We can set shipping/ship-to on the PO and a different remit-to for payments.)
3) For bank verification we require either a voided check or bank letter stamped by the bank for each account — are the attached bank letters sufficient or can you provide voided checks?
4) Portal: please complete the updated vendor onboarding form — I dropped the DocuSign link below in case it's easier.

Tentative timeline from our side: once we receive the final confirmation + voided checks (or bank stamps) we'll create two remit locations in our ERP and queue one test ACH per account. That usually takes 3–5 business days after docs are verified. Full PO mapping change (so invoices generated against hardware POs use the hardware remit account) we can schedule to become effective 2026-12-15 as requested.

Karthik — I'll need you to set up the split remit structure in NetProc and coordinate the test ACHs. Monica — looping you for any contractual/portal changes the CS side should be aware of.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_onboard_form_docusign_link.txt

—Natalie

Thanks for the context — a few operational notes from AP/ERP perspective: 

- We'll onboard Synergenics as a "split-remit" vendor in NetProc so we can map invoice line items/GLs to the correct remit account.
- We require a single test ACH (micro-deposit) to each account to complete bank validation. Please confirm a window when you can check for those deposits; we usually send them 2 business days after verification.
- Once verification clears, I will create two remit locations: "Licensing" (default for subscription invoices) and "Fulfillment" (for hardware POs). I'll also flag the vendor record with the new warehouse ship-to address.
- Please provide a point of contact for payment exceptions; Marco Ramos works if you confirm. We'll add his cell to the vendor file.

On quoting previous message:
> On Nov 28, 2026 at 9:12 AM, Natalie Tran <natalie.tran@synergenics.com> wrote:
> > Effective date for the split: 2026-12-15.

Timeline note: target is to have the test ACHs complete by 2026-12-02 so that mapping can go live 2026-12-15. If any of the verification docs are missing we'll push the date — Irene, please advise if we want an earlier tentative test deposit date.

Thanks — Karthik
